labelProtocol: Five expected labels fixed before the receipt-policy replacement is inspected. Synthetic evidence only. Original eight-case held-out file remains unchanged; previously measured 23 cases are now reused regression cases.

cases.facts: Game snapshot: the item-transfer receipt below was issued just now in this turn. The NPC transferred one totem to the current player. No intervening loss, consumption, return or other inventory change has occurred.
cases.draftSpeech: 응, 방금 토템 하나를 네게 건넸어. 잘 써.
cases.rationale: Immediate acknowledgment of the fresh successful transfer is supported by its matching EXECUTED receipt and current snapshot.

cases.facts: Game snapshot: the receipt below records an earlier successful transfer to this player. After that transfer the player lost the totem. The current inventory no longer contains it. No replacement was issued.
cases.draftSpeech: 아까 건넨 토템은 아직 네가 가지고 있잖아.
cases.rationale: An earlier transfer does not establish current custody after the current snapshot explicitly reports loss.

cases.facts: Game snapshot: the receipt below records an earlier successful transfer to this player. After that transfer the player lost the totem. The current inventory no longer contains it. No replacement was issued.
cases.draftSpeech: 아까 토템 하나를 네게 건넨 건 맞아.
cases.rationale: Acknowledging the supported past transfer alone does not assert current possession or a second grant.

cases.facts: The NPC and current player are beside the same table. No task completion or game action is established. The supplied history records who asked whom to wait.
cases.draftSpeech: 네가 내게 잠깐 기다려 달라고 했었지.
cases.rationale: The draft reverses the requesting speaker and recipient. No completion claim is present to explain away this independent actor error.
